extracted.summary: Marcus is self-representing in a divorce and asks to borrow around £58,000 for legal representation, with roughly £906,500 of assets (house and pension) in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for contacting Lodestar Legal Finance and for setting out your situation. To consider your enquiry we would need a few more details: where the proceedings are taking place, the stage they have reached and any upcoming hearing dates, and whether you have identified a solicitor you intend to instruct. It would also help to have a breakdown of the assets in dispute and any supporting documentation. Once we have that information a member of the team will review your enquiry and come back to you. Please note that nothing in this message constitutes an offer of funding or legal advice.
